method: Every npm name in dshworks/awesome-dsh-plugins data/plugins.json; the manifest npm tags latest; dsh's install gate as ported in scripts/measure-installability.mjs gate(), applied at each runtime below. No exemptions.

shapes.pin: every refusing range is one exact version
shapes.list: exact versions joined by ||, none of them 0.2.1-rc.5
shapes.mixed: exact versions or-ed with a range that ends before 0.2.1
shapes.range: a range whose upper bound is below 0.2.1-rc.5
